integrity: The fresh primary theorem was inspected for its normalization, universal sharp constant, primary classification, and sharpness example. The new calculation uses exact binomial-transform identities and a complete classification of the orbit maximum of a sine along rational or irrational rotations. No numerical approximation is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a fixed-parameter lower bound and an exact resonance profile for the canonical two-pole witness. Except at the parameter value where the universal sharp constant is attained, it does not determine the optimal fixed-parameter constant and does not exclude stronger obstructions from other sequence families.
title: Arithmetic resonance lower bounds for fixed-parameter Mashreghi–Ransford constants
